parameters.command:
={{ `cd /opt/detection-ci/wazuh-genai-ci || exit 1
set -a
[ -r ./.env.ci ] && . ./.env.ci || true
set +a
# Fresh-host safety: create parent dirs before the Python runner starts.
# This fixes FileNotFoundError for /opt/detection-ci/backups/flow-b2/<run>/wazuh.
mkdir -p /opt/detection-ci/backups/flow-b2 /opt/detection-ci/backups/flow-b2-policies /tmp/flowb /tmp/flowb/stage 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /var/ossec/tmp/deploy-flowb 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_result.json /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_signal.json /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_stdout.log /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_stderr.log
cat > /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_signal.json <<'EOF'
${JSON.stringify($json.deploy_context || {})}
EOF
python3 scripts/deploy/run_flow_b2_local_deploy.py --repo-root . --signal-json /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_signal.json --execute --output-json /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_result.json > /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_stdout.log 2> /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_stderr.log
rc=$?
if [ -s /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_result.json ]; then
  cat /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_result.json
elif [ -s /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_stdout.log ] && grep -q '"decision"' /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_stdout.log; then
  cat /tmp/flow_b2_deploy_stdout.log
else
  python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, os
err = ''
try:
    err = open('/tmp/flow_b2_deploy_stderr.log', 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').read()[-3500:]
except Exception:
    pass
out = ''
try:
    out = open('/tmp/flow_b2_deploy_stdout.log', 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').read()[-1500:]
except Exception:
    pass
print(json.dumps({"decision":"fail","deployment_status":"failed","error":"run_flow_b2_local_deploy did not create result json","stderr_tail":err,"stdout_tail":out,"returncode":int(os.environ.get('rc','1') or 1)}))
PYEOF
fi
exit 0` }}
